messages:
sara: Velociti returned the RFI with three exception items. They want a capability CSV + the completed security questionnaire and a short pricing sample. Can we pull together a tidy bundle for the AE to send by EOD Friday?
diego: Exceptions copied here: (A) customer HSM for private installs, (B) FedRAMP status for Dedicated, (C) billing for caching/KV and token counting.
anika: Paste of the customer's items: 
> Sec Q7: Can customers bring their own HSMs into your Private offering?
> Compliance Q19: Does any Redwood offering hold FedRAMP authorization?
> Billing Q3: Explain how caching changes token billing and the per-token vs per-request model.
ryan: Short-run facts to draft: HSM - private/on-prem supports customer HSM appliances + KMS integrations; Dedicated integrates with cloud KMS (customer keys), hosted multitenant does not accept customer HSM hardware. FedRAMP - not accredited as of 2026-03-20; we have a compliance roadmap and channel partners for controlled environments. Billing - Hosted: per-token; Dedicated: reservation (month commit) + overage per-token; caching lowers billed tokens (we typically see ~25-40% reduction in chat workloads).
anika: I'll compile the security answers and attach the supported KMS/HSM vendor list. Need a diagram for the HSM flow — who has the latest PNG?
diego: I exported an updated HSM diagram earlier today. Uploading to internal drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Velociti-RFI-HSM (internal). Use this language for Sec Q7: "Redwood can be configured to use customer-managed key material. In Private/on-prem deployments we support direct integration with customer HSM appliances and with customer-managed cloud KMS. Our hosted multitenant service does not host customer HSM devices." Keep it succinct.
sara: For FedRAMP Q19 please be explicit: "Redwood is not FedRAMP authorized as of 2026-03-20. We maintain a prioritized compliance roadmap and can provide a partner-assisted hosting option for regulated workloads; contact your AE for details."
ryan: For pricing sample I'll draft example numbers (placeholders): baseline reserved cluster 4xA100 = $28,000/month; expected cache reduction 35% for a chat-style workload; Dedicated overage $0.50/1k tokens; Hosted generation $0.028/1k tokens. I'll flag as estimates.
anika: Vendor list: AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, Thales Luna HSM, Utimaco. I'll mark which are validated for Private.
diego: I'll create the capability CSV. Columns: capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes. CSV snippet below: 
```
capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes
SSO,yes,yes,yes,SAML/OIDC supported across all deployments
Customer HSM,no,partial,yes,Hosted: no hardware HSM; Dedicated: cloud KMS integration; Private: supports customer HSM appliances
Model pinning,yes,yes,yes,Per-route model version control and rollout policies
KV prefix caching,yes,yes,yes,Automatic prefix/KV cache; reduces billed tokens when hits occur
Throughput SLAs,no,yes,yes,SLA available for Dedicated; Private per-contract
```

sara: Perfect. Ops-bot - please add a reminder to the AE for internal sign-off and list out required attachments.
ops-bot: Reminder created: Velociti RFI sign-off required by 2026-03-26 17:00 PT. Required attachments: capability_matrix.csv, security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, hsm_integration_diagram.png, pricing_estimate.xlsx. Notifying @sara.
anika: I'll finish the security questionnaire answers and the vendor validation table by Thursday 15:00 PT.
dryan: (typo) Ryan: I'll finalize the pricing workbook with a worked example by Thursday 12:00 PT.
diego: I'll assemble the bundle and draft the RFI reply text. Draft reply (please edit): "Thanks Velociti — attached are the capability matrix and completed security questionnaire. Short answers to exceptions: 1) HSM — Private supports customer HSM appliances and cloud KMS integrations; Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations; Hosted multitenant does not host customer HSM hardware. 2) FedRAMP — Redwood is not FedRAMP authorized as of 2026-03-20; we offer partner-assisted hosting and have a prioritized compliance roadmap. 3) Billing/caching — see attached pricing_estimate.xlsx; prefix/KV caching reduces billed token volume and can cut token costs materially depending on hit rate."
sara: Add a line offering a 60-minute architecture review with infra/SRE to validate the HSM approach. Then we should be ready.
anika: A couple of small clarifications: mark all customer-facing docs as 'internal use only' if they include placeholder pricing. Legal will sanitize before public share.
diego: Noted. I'll aim to upload the final bundle to Drive and ping AE by Thursday 17:00 PT.
sara: Thanks team. We'll regroup here if anything changes.
ops-bot: Ticket RFI-5987 updated: owner @sara, due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT.
